## Vehicle Inspection Service

Stay compliant with our comprehensive **vehicle inspection service** for commercial trucks and
trailers. We perform thorough [BIT inspections][139] and [DOT inspections][140] on your vehicle.
Contact your nearest Betts Truck Parts branch to [schedule Mobile BIT Inspections for your
fleet][141].

[Schedule a BIT or DOT Inspection][142]

## Wheel Alignment Service

Our precision [**heavy duty vehicle wheel alignment service**][143] uses advanced laser alignment
equipment designed for commercial vehicles. We perform alignments for trucks, buses, and trailers to
maximize tire life, improve fuel efficiency, and ensure safe handling on the road. Be sure to ask
your nearest branch about mobile alignment service.

[Book Alignment Service][144]

## Bendix Blindspotter Installers

As [certified installers of Bendix Blindspotter][145], we ensure your fleet is equipped with
state-of-the-art safety technology. Our expert team provides seamless installation and support,
enhancing driver awareness and preventing accidents. Trust us to protect your fleet with Bendix
Blindspotter systems for optimal safety and performance.

[Bendix Blindspotter Installation][146]

## Trailer Repair Shops

We provide [**trailer repair shop**][147] services for everything from minor maintenance and
**[trailer repair][148]** to alignments for commercial trailers. We repair landing gear, suspension
systems, axles, electrical and offer a wide range of [**trailer parts**][149] in stock at all
locations.

[Request Trailer Repairs][150]

## Heavy Duty Electrical Repairs

Our [**heavy duty** **electrical repair service**][151] include diagnosing and repairing electrical
issues in heavy-duty trucks and trailers. From alternators to complex wiring problems, our
technicians use advanced diagnostics to restore electrical system reliability. We also offer [heavy
duty electrical parts][152].

[Get Electrical Repairs][153]

## Your #1 Truck Parts Supplier

As your trusted [**truck parts supplier**][154], we stock extensive OEM and aftermarket parts for
heavy-duty trucks and trailers. From [electrical parts][155] and [brake & wheel parts][156] to
[suspension parts][157], we offer a huge inventory of brand name parts and competitive pricing at
all of our locations. Be sure to ask about parts delivery around your nearest branch location.

[Get Heavy Duty Parts][158]

## Heavy Duty Spring Shops

Our branches are known as the #1 [**heavy duty** **auto spring shops**][159] for leaf spring repair
and leaf spring replacement for commercial trucks and trailers. We rebuild spring assemblies,
replace individual leaves, and fabricate custom springs to maintain proper ride height and load
capacity.

[Get Leaf Spring Repairs][160]

## LiquidSpring Installers

Discover top-quality LiquidSpring parts and expert installation services at our eight branch
locations. As LiquidSpring installers, we ensure that you receive the best support for your
vehicles. Trust us for reliable LiquidSpring parts and exceptional service tailored to meet your
needs.

[LiquidSpring Parts & Installation][161]

## Heavy Duty Transmission Shops

As **heavy duty** **transmission shops**, our 8 branches specialize in heavy-duty commercial vehicle
[**drivetrain repair services**][162]. We perform complete rebuilds, clutch replacements, and
diagnostics for trucks and heavy equipment using OEM parts for reliable performance.

[Schedule Transmission Repairs][163]

## Truck Brake Repair Shops

Our [**semi truck brake repair shops**][164] specializes in air brake systems for tractor-trailers
and commercial semis. We handle brake adjustments, drum replacements, air line repairs, and complete
brake overhauls. Our certified technicians ensure BIT and DOT compliance and maximum stopping power
for safe highway operation. We also offer [heavy duty brake & wheel parts][165] at our
[locations][166].

[Get Brake Repairs][167]

## Heavy Duty Tech Tips

Get the most out of your truck and trailer repairs with expert tips straight from the pros. [Visit
our **Tech Tips** page][189] for guides and  guides, and downloadable brochures to help you tackle
common issues and stay road-ready.

Whether you’re troubleshooting or planning ahead, you’ll find trusted insights and tech tip
resources from our heavy duty repair experts.

[Explore Tech Tips][190]

## Truck & Trailer Parts on Sale

Save on brand name heavy duty parts on sale! Be sure to [visit our extensive online parts
store][192] to view or download sales flyers.

[See Heavy Duty Parts On Sale][193]

## Now Available! ATRO Spring Pins and Spring Pin Bushings!

Keep your truck’s suspension running smoothly with ATRO spring pins. Unlike standard pins, ATRO’s
innovative design features spiral grease grooves for optimal lubrication. This unique feature
ensures grease reaches critical wear points, significantly reducing friction and extending the life
of your suspension components. Choose ATRO for reliable performance and reduced maintenance costs.
Spring pins and bushings available now at all of our branches!

## Wheel Alignment Service

Our precision [**heavy duty vehicle wheel alignment service**][143] uses advanced laser alignment
equipment designed for commercial vehicles. We perform alignments for trucks, buses, and trailers to
maximize tire life, improve fuel efficiency, and ensure safe handling on the road. Be sure to ask
your nearest branch about mobile alignment service.

[Book Alignment Service][144]

## Bendix Blindspotter Installers

As [certified installers of Bendix Blindspotter][145], we ensure your fleet is equipped with
state-of-the-art safety technology. Our expert team provides seamless installation and support,
enhancing driver awareness and preventing accidents. Trust us to protect your fleet with Bendix
Blindspotter systems for optimal safety and performance.

[Bendix Blindspotter Installation][146]

## Trailer Repair Shops

We provide [**trailer repair shop**][147] services for everything from minor maintenance and
**[trailer repair][148]** to alignments for commercial trailers. We repair landing gear, suspension
systems, axles, electrical and offer a wide range of [**trailer parts**][149] in stock at all
locations.

[Request Trailer Repairs][150]

## Heavy Duty Electrical Repairs

Our [**heavy duty** **electrical repair service**][151] include diagnosing and repairing electrical
issues in heavy-duty trucks and trailers. From alternators to complex wiring problems, our
technicians use advanced diagnostics to restore electrical system reliability. We also offer [heavy
duty electrical parts][152].

[Get Electrical Repairs][153]

## Your #1 Truck Parts Supplier

As your trusted [**truck parts supplier**][154], we stock extensive OEM and aftermarket parts for
heavy-duty trucks and trailers. From [electrical parts][155] and [brake & wheel parts][156] to
[suspension parts][157], we offer a huge inventory of brand name parts and competitive pricing at
all of our locations. Be sure to ask about parts delivery around your nearest branch location.

[Get Heavy Duty Parts][158]

## Heavy Duty Spring Shops

Our branches are known as the #1 [**heavy duty** **auto spring shops**][159] for leaf spring repair
and leaf spring replacement for commercial trucks and trailers. We rebuild spring assemblies,
replace individual leaves, and fabricate custom springs to maintain proper ride height and load
capacity.

[Get Leaf Spring Repairs][160]

## LiquidSpring Installers

Discover top-quality LiquidSpring parts and expert installation services at our eight branch
locations. As LiquidSpring installers, we ensure that you receive the best support for your
vehicles. Trust us for reliable LiquidSpring parts and exceptional service tailored to meet your
needs.

[LiquidSpring Parts & Installation][161]

## Heavy Duty Transmission Shops

As **heavy duty** **transmission shops**, our 8 branches specialize in heavy-duty commercial vehicle
[**drivetrain repair services**][162]. We perform complete rebuilds, clutch replacements, and
diagnostics for trucks and heavy equipment using OEM parts for reliable performance.

[Schedule Transmission Repairs][163]

## Truck Brake Repair Shops

Our [**semi truck brake repair shops**][164] specializes in air brake systems for tractor-trailers

## Professional Global Tire Manufacturer and Exporter in China

**Bonway provides high-quality tyre solutions for commercial, passenger, agricultural, and
industrial applications. With advanced production facilities and strict quality standards, we serve
customers in over 80 countries with reliable products and professional support.****Our focus on

## About Bonway

Bonway Tyre is a professional tyre manufacturer and global exporter, serving customers in more than
80 countries worldwide. We specialize in TBR, PCR, OTR, agricultural, and industrial tyre solutions
designed to meet the demands of diverse markets.

With advanced production facilities, strict quality control systems, and a commitment to innovation,
Bonway delivers reliable products that combine performance, durability, and value. Our goal is to
build long-term partnerships by providing high-quality tyre solutions and professional service to
customers around the world.

 

## Market Investigation

At Bonway, we believe that understanding customer needs is the key to continuous improvement.
Through regular market visits, industry exhibitions, and direct communication with distributors and

Behind every axle, brake, fender, and engineered solution are dedicated American workers whose

[Learn MoreLearn more about Made in America][14]
DEX360 Smart Trailer System

Drive Worry Free with real-time tire pressure and temperature monitoring, GPS tracking, virtual
odometer alerts, battery level notifications, and geofencing. Whether you're on the road or away,
DEX360 keeps you informed and in control.

[Learn MoreLearn more about DEX360 Smart Trailer System][15]
Play video
FORTRESS™

Dexter's Fortress Oil Cap provides revolutionary protection for your trailer axle. Engineered with
precision, Fortress includes a durable Dexter genuine bolt-on and threaded bearing protection
solution.

[Learn MoreLearn more about FORTRESS™][16]
Play video
Pre-Greased Hub & Drum Kits

The pre-greased hub and hub-drum kits consist of American-Made, Dexter genuine parts. Pre-filled
with Dexter grease and ready to install from the box.

Learning Library

Visit the NEW Dexter Learning Library for helpful articles, answers to commonly asked questions,
maintenance tips, and more!

[View NowLearn more about Learning Library][18]
Smooth Out the Road Ahead in Style with Red E-Z Flex

While sporting a new look, Dexter’s patented pivot bushing and rubber core design will give your
unit a lifetime of superior ride quality.

[Explore NowLearn more about E-Z Flex][19]
People are the key to Dexter's success!

We’re looking for driven individuals who are committed to safety, quality, and customer service.

[Apply today!Learn more about People are the key to Dexter's success!][20]
Drive for Dexter

We are looking for CDL drivers to join our team! Each day, our drivers go the extra mile to deliver
Dexter products.

solution.

# Markets Served

Dexter provides premium products for the general utility, heavy duty commercial, cargo, boat
trailer, commercial grade, RV, construction, horse & livestock, agriculture, service replacement,
and specialty markets.

[Learn MoreLearn more about Markets Served][28]
Play video
AUTHENTIC AMERICAN MADE

Making all-American trailer axles and components that your business can depend on. Our history and
highly engineered designs are the foundation of what keeps your business moving forward.

[Learn MoreLearn more about AUTHENTIC AMERICAN MADE][29]
TROUBLE-FREE TOWING

Dexter’s brands deliver the high-performance trailer components our customer’s demand.

[Learn MoreLearn more about TROUBLE-FREE TOWING][30]
COMPREHENSIVE SUPPLIER

Dexter offers everything manufacturers, dealers, and service centers need with the most extensive
product offering in the trailering industry.

[Learn MoreLearn more about COMPREHENSIVE SUPPLIER ][31]
TOGETHER

A lot of good reputations are riding on Dexter, let us carry yours.

[Learn MoreLearn more about TOGETHER][32]
DEVOTED

At Dexter, we are devoted to creating solutions for our customers that will carry you down the road
for many years to come.

[Learn MoreLearn more about DEVOTED][33]
BRANDS TO TRUST

Dexter Group is home to the leading trailer components suppliers and manufacturers across North
America.

[Learn MoreLearn more about BRANDS TO TRUST][34]
[Close Modal][35]

## [News Announcement: Dexter Acquires City Spring & Axle Ltd. Read More >][36]

## Dexter Group

Every Dexter brand upholds our values of safety, quality, and customer service. For over 60 years,
Dexter has explicitly curated a number of industry-leading brands to fuel our growth, expand our
product portfolio, and better support our customers across North America.

[
[Dexter Logo]
Genuine Dexter Trailer Parts

Dexter excels in providing our customers with the best in value by delivering the trailer parts you
need, when you need them. **Rugged. Dependable. American made. **Available nationwide with the
industry’s best five-year warranty.

Learn More Learn more about Genuine Dexter Trailer Parts
][37] [
[Dexter Logo]
Premium Axles, Brakes & Components

Dexter is the leading North American manufacturer of premium axles and trailer components with the
most comprehensive product portfolio serving the commercial, marine, RV, specialty, and heavy-duty
towing industries.

Learn More Learn more about Premium Axles, Brakes & Components
][38] [
[Dexter Logo]
Heavy Duty and Specialty Axles

Dexter manufactures robust, highly engineered products for heavy-duty industrial applications
serving the trucking industry.

Learn More Learn more about Heavy Duty and Specialty Axles
][39] [
[Dexter Logo]
Distribution (Trailer Parts and Accessories)

Dexter is the industry’s leading supplier of trailer parts and accessories under one distribution
arm. With over 30 locations nationwide, we are posed to serve customers with performance products
and outstanding customer service.

Learn More Learn more about Distribution (Trailer Parts and Accessories)
][40] [
[Dexter Logo]
Door Products

Serving the RV and trailer market with an extensive door product line.

Learn More Learn more about Door Products
][41] [
[Dexter Logo]
Venting Solutions

Proudly manufactured in the U.S., Dexter offers a full range of quality venting products for the
housing and RV markets.

Learn More Learn more about Venting Solutions
][42] [
[Dexter Logo]
Venting Solutions - Copy

Proudly manufactured in the U.S., Dexter offers a full range of quality venting products for the
housing and RV markets.

Learn More Learn more about Venting Solutions - Copy
][43]
Contact

Learn more about Dexter^{®}, send inquiries, request information, or ask questions.

## How is Safety Designed into a Double D Trailer?

Double D Trailers are engineered from the ground up using patented safety systems designed to reduce
common injury risks during loading, travel, and unloading. Each system addresses a specific risk
point horses and handlers face in traditional horse trailer designs.
[Z-Frame®][48]
[SafeBump®][49]
[SafeKick®][50]
[SafeTack®
][51]
* #### How does the SafeTack® swing-out design make loading and unloading safer?
  
  SafeTack® relocates the tack compartment so it swings completely out of the horse’s path. This
  eliminates tight, high-risk loading and unloading areas and improves safety for both horses and
  handlers.
* #### What makes SafeKick® walls different from standard trailer walls?
  
  SafeKick® walls are flexible yet strong wall panels that rebound from kicks. This design helps
  reduce leg and joint injuries while maintaining structural integrity.
* #### How does the SafeBump® roof improve horse safety?
  
  The SafeBump® roof is an insulated, impact-resistant roof system designed to help regulate
  interior temperature and absorb force from above, improving comfort and protection during travel.
* #### What is the Z-Frame® structure, and why does it matter?
  
  The Z-Frame® is a rust-free structural frame that combines steel-level strength with aluminum
  weight savings. It is engineered to improve durability and provide added protection in the event
  of an impact while keeping overall trailer weight manageable.
* #### Do these safety features help horses travel more calmly?
  
  Yes. By improving balance, reducing impact forces, and creating a more open and predictable
  interior space, these safety systems often help horses travel more quietly and arrive less
  stressed.
* #### How are Double D Trailers different from mass-produced horse trailers?
  
  Double D Trailers are custom-built and sold factory-direct. This allows safety systems, stall
  sizes, and layouts to be matched to the horse, towing vehicle, and hauling conditions instead of
  relying on pre-built inventory.

## How is Safety Designed into a Double D Trailer?

Double D Trailers are engineered from the ground up using patented safety systems designed to reduce
common injury risks during loading, travel, and unloading. Each system addresses a specific risk
point horses and handlers face in traditional horse trailer designs.
[Z-Frame®][48]
[SafeBump®][49]
[SafeKick®][50]
[SafeTack®
][51]
* #### How does the SafeTack® swing-out design make loading and unloading safer?
  
  SafeTack® relocates the tack compartment so it swings completely out of the horse’s path. This
  eliminates tight, high-risk loading and unloading areas and improves safety for both horses and
  handlers.
* #### What makes SafeKick® walls different from standard trailer walls?
  
  SafeKick® walls are flexible yet strong wall panels that rebound from kicks. This design helps
  reduce leg and joint injuries while maintaining structural integrity.
* #### How does the SafeBump® roof improve horse safety?
  
  The SafeBump® roof is an insulated, impact-resistant roof system designed to help regulate
  interior temperature and absorb force from above, improving comfort and protection during travel.
* #### What is the Z-Frame® structure, and why does it matter?
  
  The Z-Frame® is a rust-free structural frame that combines steel-level strength with aluminum
  weight savings. It is engineered to improve durability and provide added protection in the event
  of an impact while keeping overall trailer weight manageable.
* #### Do these safety features help horses travel more calmly?
  
  Yes. By improving balance, reducing impact forces, and creating a more open and predictable
  interior space, these safety systems often help horses travel more quietly and arrive less
  stressed.
* #### How are Double D Trailers different from mass-produced horse trailers?
  
  Double D Trailers are custom-built and sold factory-direct. This allows safety systems, stall
  sizes, and layouts to be matched to the horse, towing vehicle, and hauling conditions instead of
  relying on pre-built inventory.

M/S Federal Mogul Goetze (India) Ltd. is a global supplier of quality products, trusted brands and

M/S Imperial Auto Industries has grown from a single manufacturing unit at Faridabad to present 20
manufacturing locations spread all over the country. With our growth, we found a long standing

products. I am happy with the association.

Asia or Africa. We always adhere to the principle of "honesty creates the future, serve customers

Established in 1999, Hangzhou Fuerma Industry Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer of semi-trailers
(trailers), vehicle axle assembly and other related components. Close to Hangzhou Xiaoshan
International Airport, Hu-Hang freeway and Hangzhou Stations (auto car and train), we are enjoying a
great geographical location and convenient transportation. Covering a building area of 13,000 square
meters, we have more than 150 sets of special equipment, such as numerical control cutters,
numerical control processing centers, auto welding machines, 500T/1000T four marking pressure
machines and large circular grinding machines. Our company congregates many senior vehicle axle
professionals, bringing in advanced technology from Germany and following the ISO9002 quality
management system strictly. With consummate producing technique, processing management and perfect
inspection equipment, we design, produce and sell the trailers and other vehicle axle parts
complying with the ISO, DIN and JIS standards. The Fuma series of vehicle axles and trailers can
express its excellent performance and have strong working adaptability wherever in America, Europe,
Asia or Africa. We always adhere to the principle of "honesty creates the future, serve customers
with high quality, reasonable price and perfect service". If you are interested in any of our
products, please feel free to contact us for more details.

Exclusive to Great Dane, this high-friction surface prevents slips, cuts maintenance, and eliminates
tape, backed by a 15-year warranty.

Energy-efficient lighting boosts loading safety and speed with a trailer interior that’s 74%
brighter than traditional dome lights.

### ANCHORPOINT

Our heavy-duty truck body mounting system replaces U-bolts and wood fillers, saving maintenance time
and enhancing safety.

### STRATA SIDEWALL SYSTEM

Combining our premium linings, ClimaCore insulation, and Ultra Road Shield, this system delivers
superior corrosion resistance and thermal performance.

Tire replacement is crucial for maintaining the safety and performance of your truck and trailer.

tire replacement services to keep you safe on the road.

Oil system maintenance and replacement is crucial for ensuring the longevity and performance of your

steering pump maintenance to keep your truck handling smoothly.

skilled technicians use high-quality parts and advanced equipment to ensure your trailer axle is
properly maintained. Let us help you maintain the safety and performance of your trailer with our
expert maintenance services.

Learn more

What Vehicle type do you work on?

Freightliner / Peterbilt / Kenworth / Volvo, all diesel engine commercial vehicles, big or small.

Do you work on Trailers?

Yes, Semi Trailers and some smaller trailers are welcome.

Do you have a secure facility?

YES, we have a gated facility and HD cameras with audio and video all around the yard.

What will LKG NOT do

The only thing we DON’T do is major parts overhaul like on engine / transmission / differential.
However we will replace these major parts with another reman or used part.

Does LKG or its affiliates offer any equipment for RENT while my Truck / Trailer is being worked on?

YES, Our affiliated company (PDP Trucking Inc) has the ability to recover your load and/or rent a
semi truck with a trailer to finish your load to keep your customers happy. Make sure to mention
this at the very the start to resolve this asap.

YES, LKG has the ability to provide road service call within 100 miles radius from Midlothian TX.

Does LKG provide Towing?

YES, LKG has the ability to tow equipment from within 100 miles radius from Midlothian TX if your
equipment can not be fixed on the road service.

## Common Inquiries

### Do you provide custom OEM services for specific trailer designs?

Yes. As a direct manufacturer since 2012, we specialize in [custom OEM solutions][73]. We can
manufacture trailer axles, hubs, and brakes according to your CAD drawings, including specific track
lengths, drop depths, and mounting patterns.

### Are your trailer parts compliant with North American standards?

Absolutely. All our heavy-duty components are engineered to meet or exceed **SAE J684 standards**.

and load capacity before shipping.

### What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) for wholesale?

As a B2B supplier, our MOQ typically depends on the product category. For standard [trailer
axles][74], it usually starts from 10-50 units. However, we do support smaller trial orders for new
clients to verify our quality.

### What surface treatments do you offer for corrosion resistance?

We provide multiple finish options including high-durability E-coat (electrophoretic coating),
hot-dip galvanization for marine environments, and premium powder coating. These ensure maximum
protection against salt and oxidation.

### What is your typical lead time for international shipping?

Standard orders are typically processed within 20-30 days. Custom-engineered solutions may require
35-45 days depending on the complexity of the design. We coordinate with global logistics partners
to ensure stable delivery to North America, Europe, and Australia.

## Common Inquiries

### Do you provide custom OEM services for specific trailer designs?

Yes. As a direct manufacturer since 2012, we specialize in [custom OEM solutions][73]. We can
manufacture trailer axles, hubs, and brakes according to your CAD drawings, including specific track
lengths, drop depths, and mounting patterns.

### Are your trailer parts compliant with North American standards?

Absolutely. All our heavy-duty components are engineered to meet or exceed **SAE J684 standards**.
Our facility is ISO 9001:2015 certified, ensuring rigorous batch testing for structural integrity
and load capacity before shipping.

### What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) for wholesale?

As a B2B supplier, our MOQ typically depends on the product category. For standard [trailer
axles][74], it usually starts from 10-50 units. However, we do support smaller trial orders for new
clients to verify our quality.

### What surface treatments do you offer for corrosion resistance?

We provide multiple finish options including high-durability E-coat (electrophoretic coating),
hot-dip galvanization for marine environments, and premium powder coating. These ensure maximum
protection against salt and oxidation.

### What is your typical lead time for international shipping?

Standard orders are typically processed within 20-30 days. Custom-engineered solutions may require
35-45 days depending on the complexity of the design. We coordinate with global logistics partners
to ensure stable delivery to North America, Europe, and Australia.

### Do you provide technical support for installation?

Yes, our engineering team provides comprehensive technical documentation and installation guides.
For large-scale OEM projects, we offer one-on-one consultation to ensure perfect component
integration. [Contact us][75] for more technical details.

استراتژیک در نزدیکی مرزهای چهار کشور قرار گرفته است. با اشتغال بیش از 900 نفر نیروی متخصص، مارال

# مارال صنعت جاوید

شرکت مارال صنعت جاوید، با نام تجاری مارال تریلر، به عنوان یکی از بزرگترین تولیدکنندگان تریلر در
ایران شناخته می‌شود. این مجموعه صنعتی در زمینی به مساحت 100,000 متر مربع در ارومیه، در موقعیتی
استراتژیک در نزدیکی مرزهای چهار کشور قرار گرفته است. با اشتغال بیش از 900 نفر نیروی متخصص، مارال
صنعت جاوید با تکیه بر ظرفیت عظیم تولید و نیروی انسانی متعهد، تضمین‌کننده کیفیت و دوام در صنعت حمل و
نقل جاده‌ای کشور است.

### مهندسی شده برای حمل و نقل

تیم مهندسی مارال صنعت، محصولات خود را با دانش فنی روز و به طور اختصاصی برای صنعت حمل و نقل طراحی
می‌کند تا بهره‌وری و عملکرد وسیله نقلیه شما را بهبود بخشد.

[کیفیت ساخت بالا]

### کیفیت ساخت بالا

محصولات مارال صنعت با بهترین مواد اولیه و مهندسی دقیق ساخته شده‌اند تا استهلاک کم و عمر طولانی داشته
باشند، که به کاهش هزینه‌های شما کمک می‌کند.

[خدمات گسترده پس از فروش]

### خدمات گسترده پس از فروش

خدمات پس از فروش گسترده مارال صنعت، با بیش از ۲۰ مرکز در سراسر ایران، پشتیبانی سریع و جامع را برای
رانندگان در زمینه تعمیر، نگهداری و تأمین قطعات فراهم می‌کند.

[به فکرتان هستیم]

### به فکرتان هستیم

ضمانت ۱۰۰,۰۰۰ کیلومتر یا ۱۲ ماهه مارال صنعت، کیفیت و دوام بی‌نظیر محصولات ما را تضمین می‌کند و به
رانندگان آرامش خاطر می‌دهد.

# مارال صنعت جاوید

شرکت مارال صنعت جاوید، با نام تجاری مارال تریلر، به عنوان یکی از بزرگترین تولیدکنندگان تریلر در
ایران شناخته می‌شود. این مجموعه صنعتی در زمینی به مساحت 100,000 متر مربع در ارومیه، در موقعیتی
استراتژیک در نزدیکی مرزهای چهار کشور قرار گرفته است. با اشتغال بیش از 900 نفر نیروی متخصص، مارال
صنعت جاوید با تکیه بر ظرفیت عظیم تولید و نیروی انسانی متعهد، تضمین‌کننده کیفیت و دوام در صنعت حمل و
نقل جاده‌ای کشور است.

محصولات مارال صنعت با بهترین مواد اولیه و مهندسی دقیق ساخته شده‌اند تا استهلاک کم و عمر طولانی داشته
باشند، که به کاهش هزینه‌های شما کمک می‌کند.

رانندگان در زمینه تعمیر، نگهداری و تأمین قطعات فراهم می‌کند.

[به فکرتان هستیم]

ضمانت ۱۰۰,۰۰۰ کیلومتر یا ۱۲ ماهه مارال صنعت، کیفیت و دوام بی‌نظیر محصولات ما را تضمین می‌کند و به

# Best Crane Leasing Company In Singapore

In the bustling construction industry of Singapore, crane leasing has become an essential service.
Cranes play a pivotal role in lifting and transporting heavy materials, streamlining operations and
ensuring the timely completion of projects. At the forefront of this vital sector is Pollisum, an
industry leader committed to excellence and innovation.

## Crane Leasing in Singapore With Pollisum

As a company with decades of experience, Pollisum has earned multiple awards, cementing our status
as a reliable service provider in the construction industry. Since our founding in 1984, we have
grown from a simple crane mechanical repair company to a leading crane leasing company with over 250
employees in Singapore and Malaysia.We combine a young and vibrant team of professional engineers,
drivers, and operators with competitive pricing to offer unmatched leasing services. Our expertise
extends across various industries, ensuring we can meet your project’s needs.


## Engage With The Best Crane Leasing Company In Singapore

Whether you’re in the construction industry, oil and gas, or any of the various industries we serve,
Pollisum has the equipment and expertise to meet your needs.

Our diverse fleet and experienced professional engineers ensure your operations run smoothly and
efficiently.

Don’t hesitate! Engage with Pollisum today to avail of our other top-notch services, including
[transport leasing][51], [marine][52], and [fabrication][53].

With Pollisum, elevate your construction game to new heights.

## Frequently Asked Questions About Crane Leasing In Singapore

### [ How Does The Leasing Process Work, And What Documents Are Needed?][54]

The leasing process typically starts with a consultation to identify your specific needs. Required
documents generally include a business licence, proof of insurance, and identification of the person
responsible for the lease.

### [ Are There Any Insurance Requirements For Leasing A Crane In Singapore?][55]

Yes. Valid motor insurance policy is required for all motor vehicles in Singapore, and Pollisum is
no exception. We are renowned for our emphasis on safety and professionalism as a crane leasing
company in Singapore. 

We ensure all our leased cranes meet these standards, further reinforcing our commitment to
providing the best for our clients.

### [ What Is The Minimum And Maximum Lease Duration For Cranes?][56]

At Pollisum, our lease period are as follows:
* Per Trip (3 hours)
* Half Day (4 hours)
* Full Day (8 hours)
* Monthly

Apart from these, Pollisum also handles long-term projects and deploy our vehicles to construction
sites. In such cases, the lease period could last up to several months or years.

### [ Can The Leased Crane Be Used Outside Of Singapore?][57]

Generally, leased cranes are meant for use within Singapore. However, special arrangements can
sometimes be made outside the country, subject to additional terms and conditions.

### [ Are Operators And Maintenance Services Included In The Crane Leasing Package?][58]

Yes. All our cranes come with operators. Apart from that, we perform regular maintenance on our
vehicles to ensure that they are in tip top condition. However, there are instances where client
might request additional maintenance or configuration that are charge separately

### [ Can The Crane Be Customised Or Fitted With Special Equipment During The Lease?][59]

Yes, cranes can often be customised or fitted with special equipment like buckets or hooks, usually
at an additional cost and subject to availability.

# Best Crane Leasing Company In Singapore

In the bustling construction industry of Singapore, crane leasing has become an essential service.
Cranes play a pivotal role in lifting and transporting heavy materials, streamlining operations and
ensuring the timely completion of projects. At the forefront of this vital sector is Pollisum, an
industry leader committed to excellence and innovation.

## Crane Leasing in Singapore With Pollisum

As a company with decades of experience, Pollisum has earned multiple awards, cementing our status
as a reliable service provider in the construction industry. Since our founding in 1984, we have
grown from a simple crane mechanical repair company to a leading crane leasing company with over 250
employees in Singapore and Malaysia.We combine a young and vibrant team of professional engineers,
drivers, and operators with competitive pricing to offer unmatched leasing services. Our expertise
extends across various industries, ensuring we can meet your project’s needs.


## Engage With The Best Crane Leasing Company In Singapore

Whether you’re in the construction industry, oil and gas, or any of the various industries we serve,
Pollisum has the equipment and expertise to meet your needs.

Our diverse fleet and experienced professional engineers ensure your operations run smoothly and
efficiently.

Don’t hesitate! Engage with Pollisum today to avail of our other top-notch services, including
[transport leasing][51], [marine][52], and [fabrication][53].

With Pollisum, elevate your construction game to new heights.

## Frequently Asked Questions About Crane Leasing In Singapore

### [ How Does The Leasing Process Work, And What Documents Are Needed?][54]

The leasing process typically starts with a consultation to identify your specific needs. Required
documents generally include a business licence, proof of insurance, and identification of the person
responsible for the lease.

### [ Are There Any Insurance Requirements For Leasing A Crane In Singapore?][55]

Yes. Valid motor insurance policy is required for all motor vehicles in Singapore, and Pollisum is
no exception. We are renowned for our emphasis on safety and professionalism as a crane leasing
company in Singapore. 

We ensure all our leased cranes meet these standards, further reinforcing our commitment to
providing the best for our clients.

### [ What Is The Minimum And Maximum Lease Duration For Cranes?][56]

At Pollisum, our lease period are as follows:
* Per Trip (3 hours)
* Half Day (4 hours)
* Full Day (8 hours)
* Monthly

Apart from these, Pollisum also handles long-term projects and deploy our vehicles to construction
sites. In such cases, the lease period could last up to several months or years.

### [ Can The Leased Crane Be Used Outside Of Singapore?][57]

Generally, leased cranes are meant for use within Singapore. However, special arrangements can
sometimes be made outside the country, subject to additional terms and conditions.

### [ Are Operators And Maintenance Services Included In The Crane Leasing Package?][58]

Yes. All our cranes come with operators. Apart from that, we perform regular maintenance on our
vehicles to ensure that they are in tip top condition. However, there are instances where client
might request additional maintenance or configuration that are charge separately

### [ Can The Crane Be Customised Or Fitted With Special Equipment During The Lease?][59]

Yes, cranes can often be customised or fitted with special equipment like buckets or hooks, usually
at an additional cost and subject to availability.

##### 6 Factors You Need to Consider

## When Purchasing Trailer Hubs and Axles

## Type of trailer axle & hub

The trailer axle is a square or round shaft which comes in three styles, straight axles, drop axles,
and torsion axles. Lazy hubs, hub drums, and disc hubs are the common types of trailer hubs. Select
the right one according to your market and application request.

## Hub face and spring center dimension

The generally accepted measurements that define spring axles are hub face, spring center, and
overhang. 

## Load / Capacity of trailer axle & hub

The load rating of the trailer axle needs to support the maximum gross vehicle weight (GVW), which
refers to the weight of the trailer and the weight of the intended cargo. If your trailer has more
than one axle, split the GVW by the variety of axles to determine the optimum load capacity of each
axle.

## Mounting Position

The mounting position is usually the measured position where the axle is attached to the frame of
the trailer. That is the distance from the center of the spring for a leaf spring and the mounting
position is determined by this.

## SPRING CENTER DIMENSION

Hub face is a measurement that defines the space between the outside faces of the hub. This is the
face that the bolts protrude from, and the wheel touches. Spring center measures the space between
the center of the leaf springs. Overhang is simply the space between the hub face and spring center.

## Brakes (or not)

Some trailer axles have brakes, some don't. To see if you need them, review your state regulations.
There are a few types of electrical or hydraulic or mechanical actuation to choose from, such as
drum brakes or disc brakes.

##### 6 Factors You Need to Consider

## When Purchasing Trailer Hubs and Axles

## Type of trailer axle & hub

The trailer axle is a square or round shaft which comes in three styles, straight axles, drop axles,
and torsion axles. Lazy hubs, hub drums, and disc hubs are the common types of trailer hubs. Select
the right one according to your market and application request.

## Hub face and spring center dimension

The generally accepted measurements that define spring axles are hub face, spring center, and
overhang. 

## Load / Capacity of trailer axle & hub

The load rating of the trailer axle needs to support the maximum gross vehicle weight (GVW), which
refers to the weight of the trailer and the weight of the intended cargo. If your trailer has more
than one axle, split the GVW by the variety of axles to determine the optimum load capacity of each
axle.

## Mounting Position

The mounting position is usually the measured position where the axle is attached to the frame of
the trailer. That is the distance from the center of the spring for a leaf spring and the mounting
position is determined by this.

## SPRING CENTER DIMENSION

Hub face is a measurement that defines the space between the outside faces of the hub. This is the
face that the bolts protrude from, and the wheel touches. Spring center measures the space between
the center of the leaf springs. Overhang is simply the space between the hub face and spring center.

## Brakes (or not)

Some trailer axles have brakes, some don't. To see if you need them, review your state regulations.
There are a few types of electrical or hydraulic or mechanical actuation to choose from, such as
drum brakes or disc brakes.

Arrington Performance 426 HEMI Engines & Chrysler Vehicle Calibration
In the spirit of the classic 1960's Hemi 426 engines, the new Gen III 426 cubic inch HEMI is the must-have forged block for high-power HEMI builds. Click here or the logo for a lot more!
There is nothing like a custom build with our performance upgrades. We specialize in HEMI. We use the latest equipment to give you great power with the safety margin you want. Give us a call today and let us start building your dream for you. 810-522-6727
Ed's 426 HEMI Powered, Arrington Supercharged 2011 Challenger RT!
Fred's 440 HEMI Powered, 2009 Challenger SRT!
Scott's Updated 426 HEMI Powered 2011 Challenger!
Robb's 392 HEMI Powered, Magnuson Supercharged 2015 RAM 2500 Truck!
Red's 426 HEMI Powered 2012 Charger SRT!
Bill's 448 HEMI Powered 2016 RAM 1500 Truck!
HOT HEMI Parts
Arrington Performance HEMI Stroker Engines
Arrington has built, shipped and supported more hi-power HEMI-based engines than anyone. Rebuilt from an old block or upgrading a brand-new block, we use the finest forged crankshafts, connecting rods and pistons. Our blocks, heads and valves are machined on state of the art CNC machining centers and everything is inspected, built and tested in-house, including available engine dyno and chassis dyno. Change a 5.7L into a forged 6.4L 392, ready to be supercharged. Update a 6.1L to a 426 cu in monster. Or go all-out for 440 cu in, made from a 392 block. Buy only the short block, the full long block with ported heads, or a complete crate engine with controller - ready to drop into a hot rod or resto-mod.
Arrington-powered cars are the most fun and most reliable to drive.
Supercharge Your Ride
Arrington is an authorized dealer and installer for superchargers by Arrington, Magnuson, Whipple, Procharger, Edelbrock, Kenne Bell, and Vortech. We have sold and installed hundreds of superchargers, all with our in-house custom tunes (unless you want just the manufacturer's stock tune). Our stand-by favorite for its combination of power and reliability is the Arrington Hi-Power Supercharger Kit co-developed with Magnuson and based on the Eaton TVS roots-style rotors which are standard in the Corvette Z06, every supercharged Audi, and the Jaguar F-Type.
Plus we have Whipple, maker of twin-screw blowers since 1987, with a complete, bolt-on, and intercooled 2.9L twin-screw supercharger system for any of the Gen 3 HEMI engines. While the system was engineered with stock engines in mind, the 2.9L has enough capacity to support 800HP using one of our forged blocks. For the truly unique experience, Arrington is also the only dealer we know of that has fit multiple Whipple 4.0L superchargers to hi-power HEMI engines using our proprietary 4.0L setup.
2 Bar VS 3 Bar Map Sensors
Customers sometimes ask, how do I tell the difference between a 2 bar and a 3 bar map sensor? The image below shows the difference between the two boost sensors. As you can see, it can be hard to distinguish between the two. even with the 2 sensors side by side. Notice that they both have the same part number on the first line, but the 3 bar sensor on the left has two additional lines of numbers. Whereas the 2 bar sensor on the right has only one additional line...
Advantages of Mahle Forged Pistons
While MAHLE supplies OEM pistons for the HEMI 5.7 and the 6.1L engines, which are cast and designed only to accommodate the OE manufacturers original specifications, the ones supplied to Arrington Manufacturing / ShopHEMI by MAHLE Motorsports are the forged variety.The following information is useful to help distinguish between...
Arrington Performance Transmissions
ShopHEMI offers multiple high-performance transmission options. We can customize a HEMI transmission purpose built by NAG1 specialists to maximize the performance of your specific vehicle, power output, and engine type. We have race and street proven NAG1 setups designed for HEMI engines with Twin screws superchargers, centrifugal superchargers, turbochargers, NA stroker internals, and bolt-on modifications...
Arrington Line of Performance Camshafts
Arrington offers a variety of high performance camshafts. These camshafts have been engineered with the latest technology to give your HEMI engine the maximum horsepower and torque. ShopHEMI offers the ST-3A and SR-2B to complement your Dodge, Chrysler, or Jeep motor....

In the spirit of the classic 1960's Hemi 426 engines, the new Gen III 426 cubic inch HEMI is the must-have forged block for high-power HEMI builds. Click here or the logo for a lot more!
There is nothing like a custom build with our performance upgrades. We specialize in HEMI. We use the latest equipment to give you great power with the safety margin you want. Give us a call today and let us start building your dream for you. 810-522-6727
Ed's 426 HEMI Powered, Arrington Supercharged 2011 Challenger RT!
Fred's 440 HEMI Powered, 2009 Challenger SRT!

Robb's 392 HEMI Powered, Magnuson Supercharged 2015 RAM 2500 Truck!
Red's 426 HEMI Powered 2012 Charger SRT!
Bill's 448 HEMI Powered 2016 RAM 1500 Truck!
HOT HEMI Parts
Arrington Performance HEMI Stroker Engines
Arrington has built, shipped and supported more hi-power HEMI-based engines than anyone. Rebuilt from an old block or upgrading a brand-new block, we use the finest forged crankshafts, connecting rods and pistons. Our blocks, heads and valves are machined on state of the art CNC machining centers and everything is inspected, built and tested in-house, including available engine dyno and chassis dyno. Change a 5.7L into a forged 6.4L 392, ready to be supercharged. Update a 6.1L to a 426 cu in monster. Or go all-out for 440 cu in, made from a 392 block. Buy only the short block, the full long block with ported heads, or a complete crate engine with controller - ready to drop into a hot rod or resto-mod.
Arrington-powered cars are the most fun and most reliable to drive.
Supercharge Your Ride
Arrington is an authorized dealer and installer for superchargers by Arrington, Magnuson, Whipple, Procharger, Edelbrock, Kenne Bell, and Vortech. We have sold and installed hundreds of superchargers, all with our in-house custom tunes (unless you want just the manufacturer's stock tune). Our stand-by favorite for its combination of power and reliability is the Arrington Hi-Power Supercharger Kit co-developed with Magnuson and based on the Eaton TVS roots-style rotors which are standard in the Corvette Z06, every supercharged Audi, and the Jaguar F-Type.
Plus we have Whipple, maker of twin-screw blowers since 1987, with a complete, bolt-on, and intercooled 2.9L twin-screw supercharger system for any of the Gen 3 HEMI engines. While the system was engineered with stock engines in mind, the 2.9L has enough capacity to support 800HP using one of our forged blocks. For the truly unique experience, Arrington is also the only dealer we know of that has fit multiple Whipple 4.0L superchargers to hi-power HEMI engines using our proprietary 4.0L setup.
2 Bar VS 3 Bar Map Sensors
Customers sometimes ask, how do I tell the difference between a 2 bar and a 3 bar map sensor? The image below shows the difference between the two boost sensors. As you can see, it can be hard to distinguish between the two. even with the 2 sensors side by side. Notice that they both have the same part number on the first line, but the 3 bar sensor on the left has two additional lines of numbers. Whereas the 2 bar sensor on the right has only one additional line...
Advantages of Mahle Forged Pistons
While MAHLE supplies OEM pistons for the HEMI 5.7 and the 6.1L engines, which are cast and designed only to accommodate the OE manufacturers original specifications, the ones supplied to Arrington Manufacturing / ShopHEMI by MAHLE Motorsports are the forged variety.The following information is useful to help distinguish between...
Arrington Performance Transmissions
ShopHEMI offers multiple high-performance transmission options. We can customize a HEMI transmission purpose built by NAG1 specialists to maximize the performance of your specific vehicle, power output, and engine type. We have race and street proven NAG1 setups designed for HEMI engines with Twin screws superchargers, centrifugal superchargers, turbochargers, NA stroker internals, and bolt-on modifications...
Arrington Line of Performance Camshafts
Arrington offers a variety of high performance camshafts. These camshafts have been engineered with the latest technology to give your HEMI engine the maximum horsepower and torque. ShopHEMI offers the ST-3A and SR-2B to complement your Dodge, Chrysler, or Jeep motor....

repair and the components used.

#### Can Radiator be repaired?

Although the radiator may be one of the cheaper components in the TRUCK / RVs / GENERATOR engine, it
can still cost hundreds to have it repaired or replaced. Just one bottle of K-Seal could save you a
lot of money by fixing an engine coolant leak instead of you having to replace the parts.

#### How long do semi truck brakes last?

As a general rule of thumb, there’s about a 40,000-mile range in play. The average brake pad life is
somewhere around 25,000 to 65,000 miles. However, many people have heard of brake pads lasting more
than 70,000 miles, even beyond the 80,000-mile threshold. You may have even experienced super-long

### FAQ

#### How much does it cost to repair brakes?

Brake repair varies based on the vehicle’s make and model, as well as the specific parts being
replaced—such as pads, rotors, or calipers. The total can differ depending on the extent of the
repair and the components used.

#### Can Radiator be repaired?

Although the radiator may be one of the cheaper components in the TRUCK / RVs / GENERATOR engine, it
can still cost hundreds to have it repaired or replaced. Just one bottle of K-Seal could save you a
lot of money by fixing an engine coolant leak instead of you having to replace the parts.

#### How long do semi truck brakes last?

As a general rule of thumb, there’s about a 40,000-mile range in play. The average brake pad life is
somewhere around 25,000 to 65,000 miles. However, many people have heard of brake pads lasting more
than 70,000 miles, even beyond the 80,000-mile threshold. You may have even experienced super-long
brake pad wear yourself.

## OUR FACTORY
* Custom Semi Trailer Manufacturer And Factory
  As one of the largest semi trailer manufacturers, Vehicle Master has some of the largest factories
  and advanced manufacturing machineries.We have dedicated factory units and technicians responsible
  for the manufacturing of different types of semi trailers such as fuel tank semi trailer, bulk
  cement (powder) semi trailer, side wall and fence semi trailer, rear/end dump and side dump semi
  trailer, and so on.
  [Read More ][83]
  [Custom Semi Trailer Manufacturer And Factory]
* Semi Trailer Factory Production Line
  Here's is a brief walk-through of one of Vehicle Master's semi trailer factory unit. You will get
  a general idea of what our factories look like, how our semi trailer production lines work, and
  the environment of our factories. You will also have a better understanding of Vehicle Master's
  factory size and production capacity.
  [Read More ][84]
  [Semi Trailer Factory Production Line]
* Semi Trailer Factory - Frame Welding
  At Vehicle Master semi trailer factory, we are all about the details. We believe that great
  quality comes from taking care of small details. As you can see in this video, Vehicle Master's
  technicians don't disappoint at all. From a single welding point to the reinforcing plates on the
  trailer frame, they have been doing a beautiful job on these trailers.
  [Read More ][85]
  [Semi Trailer Factory - Frame Welding]
* Semi Trailer Manufacturer - Advanced Painting System
  What you are looking at is one of Vehicle Master's most expensive and advanced large machine - the
  automated painting system. This advanced painting system costs millions of American dollars to
  purchase and is well worth the money. Semi trailers that need painting go in from one side of the
  system, gets painted through steps of procedures, and come out with the beautiful coat of paint
  from the other side. This machine is so large that it spreads across the entire factory unit and
  takes about 1/3 of the space in this factory unit.
  [Read More ][86]
  [Semi Trailer Manufacturer - Advanced Painting System]

## LATEST NEWS

[ [平板1-1-1.jpg] ][87]
[3 Axles 40/60ft Flatbed Semi Trailer Design Adapted For African Containers & Machinery][88]

Are you looking for a multifunctional flatbed semi trailer suitable for container, pallet cargo and
machinery transportation in Africa? Vehicle Master’s 3 axle 40/60ft flatbed semi trailer has been
structurally optimized for the African market, featuring stable load capacity, low maintenance
requirements and high cost performance. It is perfectly suitable for standard containers,
engineering equipment and oversized bulk cargo transportation, making it an ideal choice for
supporting logistics, mining and infrastructure construction projects in Africa.

[Read More][89]
[ [绿色自卸-6-1.jpg] ][90]
[Tipper Semi Trailer For Kenya | 60 Ton Dump Trailer For Nairobi Sand & Ore Transport][91]

Driven by large-scale urban redevelopment, road infrastructure construction, and mining development
in Nairobi and across Kenya, the demand for high-capacity, compliant bulk transportation equipment
continues to grow rapidly. The 60-ton tipper semi trailer is currently the most popular and
cost-effective model for transporting sand, gravel, construction aggregates, stone, and various
ores. Vehicle Master's tipper semi trailer is specially designed for Kenya's local operating
conditions and strictly complies with East African Community (EAC) axle load regulations. While
ensuring high transportation efficiency, it features a wear-resistant cargo body and a
high-temperature-resistant hydraulic system, effectively solving the common problems of ordinary
semi trailers, such as deformation, rapid wear, and frequent breakdowns under Kenya's complex road
conditions.

[Read More][92]
[ [罐1-4-1.jpg] ][93]
[Best Fuel Tanker Trailer Manufacturer for African Markets][94]

With the rapid development of the energy industry in Africa, the demand for cross-border fuel
distribution and gasoline and diesel transportation continues to increase. However, Africa's hot
climate, rough gravel roads, and frequent overloading create a strong demand for reliable fuel
tanker trailers. As a leading fuel tanker trailer manufacturer, Vehicle Master offers customizable
capacities ranging from 20,000 liters to 60,000 liters, with tank body options including carbon
steel, aluminum alloy, and stainless steel, as well as 1 to 9 independent compartments. Every fuel
tanker trailer is specially reinforced, upgraded with anti-corrosion and dustproof features for the
African market, effectively solving the common problems found in ordinary low-cost fuel tankers.

[Read More][95]

## OUR FACTORY
* Custom Semi Trailer Manufacturer And Factory
  As one of the largest semi trailer manufacturers, Vehicle Master has some of the largest factories
  and advanced manufacturing machineries.We have dedicated factory units and technicians responsible
  for the manufacturing of different types of semi trailers such as fuel tank semi trailer, bulk
  cement (powder) semi trailer, side wall and fence semi trailer, rear/end dump and side dump semi
  trailer, and so on.
  [Read More ][83]
  [Custom Semi Trailer Manufacturer And Factory]
* Semi Trailer Factory Production Line
  Here's is a brief walk-through of one of Vehicle Master's semi trailer factory unit. You will get
  a general idea of what our factories look like, how our semi trailer production lines work, and
  the environment of our factories. You will also have a better understanding of Vehicle Master's
  factory size and production capacity.
  [Read More ][84]
  [Semi Trailer Factory Production Line]
* Semi Trailer Factory - Frame Welding
  At Vehicle Master semi trailer factory, we are all about the details. We believe that great
  quality comes from taking care of small details. As you can see in this video, Vehicle Master's
  technicians don't disappoint at all. From a single welding point to the reinforcing plates on the
  trailer frame, they have been doing a beautiful job on these trailers.
  [Read More ][85]
  [Semi Trailer Factory - Frame Welding]
* Semi Trailer Manufacturer - Advanced Painting System
  What you are looking at is one of Vehicle Master's most expensive and advanced large machine - the
  automated painting system. This advanced painting system costs millions of American dollars to
  purchase and is well worth the money. Semi trailers that need painting go in from one side of the
  system, gets painted through steps of procedures, and come out with the beautiful coat of paint
  from the other side. This machine is so large that it spreads across the entire factory unit and
  takes about 1/3 of the space in this factory unit.
  [Read More ][86]
  [Semi Trailer Manufacturer - Advanced Painting System]

## LATEST NEWS

[ [平板1-1-1.jpg] ][87]
[3 Axles 40/60ft Flatbed Semi Trailer Design Adapted For African Containers & Machinery][88]

Are you looking for a multifunctional flatbed semi trailer suitable for container, pallet cargo and
machinery transportation in Africa? Vehicle Master’s 3 axle 40/60ft flatbed semi trailer has been
structurally optimized for the African market, featuring stable load capacity, low maintenance
requirements and high cost performance. It is perfectly suitable for standard containers,
engineering equipment and oversized bulk cargo transportation, making it an ideal choice for
supporting logistics, mining and infrastructure construction projects in Africa.

[Read More][89]
[ [绿色自卸-6-1.jpg] ][90]
[Tipper Semi Trailer For Kenya | 60 Ton Dump Trailer For Nairobi Sand & Ore Transport][91]

Driven by large-scale urban redevelopment, road infrastructure construction, and mining development
in Nairobi and across Kenya, the demand for high-capacity, compliant bulk transportation equipment
continues to grow rapidly. The 60-ton tipper semi trailer is currently the most popular and
cost-effective model for transporting sand, gravel, construction aggregates, stone, and various
ores. Vehicle Master's tipper semi trailer is specially designed for Kenya's local operating
conditions and strictly complies with East African Community (EAC) axle load regulations. While
ensuring high transportation efficiency, it features a wear-resistant cargo body and a
high-temperature-resistant hydraulic system, effectively solving the common problems of ordinary
semi trailers, such as deformation, rapid wear, and frequent breakdowns under Kenya's complex road
conditions.

[Read More][92]
[ [罐1-4-1.jpg] ][93]
[Best Fuel Tanker Trailer Manufacturer for African Markets][94]

With the rapid development of the energy industry in Africa, the demand for cross-border fuel
distribution and gasoline and diesel transportation continues to increase. However, Africa's hot
climate, rough gravel roads, and frequent overloading create a strong demand for reliable fuel
tanker trailers. As a leading fuel tanker trailer manufacturer, Vehicle Master offers customizable
capacities ranging from 20,000 liters to 60,000 liters, with tank body options including carbon
steel, aluminum alloy, and stainless steel, as well as 1 to 9 independent compartments. Every fuel
tanker trailer is specially reinforced, upgraded with anti-corrosion and dustproof features for the
African market, effectively solving the common problems found in ordinary low-cost fuel tankers.

Redefining Excellence in the Recreational Vehicle & Trailer Industry

## Who We Are

At Terran Industries, we integrate our attention to detail with the quality in design and
manufacturing to engineer experiences that elevate your journey. As a key player in the Recreational
Vehicle (RV) and trailer industry, we take pride in being innovators with our customers.

## What We Do

Terran Industries, a key player in the RV and trailer industry since 2019, combines decades of axle
expertise with advanced technology to offer premium, durable products. As North America’s
third-largest RV axle supplier and a key RV and trailer component provider, we are known for our
quality and customer service. Terran Industries is redefining RV and trailer quality standards with
a diverse product range and a strong focus on customer satisfaction. Join us in shaping the future
of RV adventures.

industry norms, constantly pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Our dedication to innovation
is what sets us apart.

the RV and trailer axle market. Component parts are precision-made using automated robotic welds
